$description: One entry per distinct PAGE SHAPE, not per route. Each template's `nodes` array is structured objects — never bare strings — so `required` and `repeatable` are machine-enforceable. chrome.navbar and chrome.footer are mounted once OUTSIDE the router (src/App.jsx:28 and src/App.jsx:42) and are therefore present on every route; they are listed explicitly in every template's node sequence so a PageSpec describes a complete rendered page.

home.landing.name: Homepage
home.landing.shape: The single scroll-scrubbed marketing landing page. Used by exactly one route.

nodes.instanceNote: 'Scale with confidence' — the SECOND card grid on this page. content.card-grid's maxPerPage of 2 exists for exactly this.

product.feature.name: Product feature page
product.feature.shape: Hero with a product screenshot, then a single 3-up feature grid, then the final CTA. One component (ProductPage.jsx) serves all 10 product routes, data-driven from productContent.js.
contentInvariants: ALL 10 product routes carry an eyebrow above the h2. The four observed eyebrow values are 'Accounts', 'Money movement', 'Developer & billing' and 'Features'. An earlier extraction pass wrongly reported that /identity, /observability, /disputes and /compliance had NO eyebrow — it inferred that from DOM node counts rather than reading the text. The eyebrow field is therefore REQUIRED on this template's card-grid node, not optional.
Every route's card-grid has exactly 3 cards. Verified across all 10.

company.narrative.name: Company narrative page
company.narrative.shape: Centered statement hero, mid-page splash + story, then a run of editorial sections, closing on the final CTA. /about and /careers are the same shape with different middle sections.
company.narrative.sectionOrderNote: The optional nodes are declared in the union order across both routes. /about uses team-roster then investor-wall; /careers uses team-quote-row, perks-grid, then open-roles. A PageSpec must use a SUBSEQUENCE of this list — it may skip optional nodes but may not reorder them.

index.posts.name: Post index page
index.posts.shape: A featured post as the hero, the full filtered listing, then a newsletter capture. No final CTA and no splash on this shape.
index.posts.noFinalCtaNote: This shape deliberately ends on conversion.newsletter rather than conversion.final-cta. It is one of only two routes on the site with no final CTA / brand splash.

commerce.pricing.name: Pricing page
commerce.pricing.shape: Left-aligned statement hero, the full pricing matrix, then the final CTA.

form.single.name: Single-form page
form.single.shape: One vertically-centered form filling the viewport. No hero, no final CTA, no splash. The most structurally unusual shape on the site.
form.single.noHeroNote: This template has NO hero section at all. Any ONE_HERO-style rule must name this template as an exception rather than rejecting it.
form.single.noFinalCtaNote: Confirmed against live: /contact has no .splash element and does not load nature-desk.jpg. It is the other of the two routes with no final CTA.
